name: Provably Fair (explainer + verifier)
note: All 9 required frames exist (Empty / Verified / Failed at 1440, 768 and 390). I checked each one with screenshots and fixed what they showed. Page layout: casino shell (Shell/Sidebar with Provably Fair active, Topbar, Footer Mega; tablet uses Topbar + Footer Tablet; mobile uses Topbar Mobile + Mobile Tab Bar on Games). Content: hero with concrete dice, a playing card and product-UI previews (a VRF receipt card and a seed-check card) on angled solid blocks. There are two explainer diagrams: Chainlink VRF (round closes at 20:00:00 → request 0x9f2c…e71a → proof at 20:00:41 → settled 20:02:10) and seed commit–reveal (8f3c1e…e813 → nova-k-7f2a91 · 417 → c71d0a…5c27b14 → Roll 73.21), plus the code algorithm. Verifier: the Game/Provably Fair Verifier instance switches variant per state. Per-state panels: Empty = where to find values + recent draws #1,247/#1,246/#1,245 cancelled/#1,244; Verified = 3-check report + bet details + offline code; Failed = expected vs computed hash, 63/64 characters, likely causes, report/support. Also a FAQ (including 'you can lose your stake'), licence notice, 18+ and an RG link. Not VERIFIED for 2 reasons: (1) one copy fix on 768 Failed (34:501111) is not applied because of the Figma rate limit; (2) the 'Global Pool draw · VRF' segment is shown only as an inactive tab — there is no screen with a VRF-request-ID input.
